content:
A new Apple TV 4K is set to launch in the coming weeks, expected to make its debut at the iPhone event. Code leaks discovered by MacRumors in Apple software reveal that a new Siri Remote will be unveiled alongside it.

macOS code mentions next-generation Apple TV remote

Apple released a series of public and beta software updates yesterday. Among them, the macOS 26.7 RC contains references to several unreleased products.

MacRumors gave an example, noting they discovered a video demonstrating how AirPods with a camera would operate.

The new Apple TV 4K Siri Remote also appears in the list of unreleased products. Juli Clover writes:

Mark Gurman previously reported that the upcoming hardware refresh would feature an Apple TV remote that has 'likely been tweaked'.

The discovery of this next-generation Siri Remote in macOS 26.7 suggests that the new remote will officially arrive this autumn.

There are currently no rumours detailing specific changes to the new remote. However, one of the most commonly raised feature requests is the ability to locate a lost remote more easily. Perhaps Apple will incorporate the second-generation ultra-wideband chip used in the AirTag 2 into the Siri Remote.

What changes would you like to see in the next-generation Apple TV 4K Siri Remote? Let us know in the comments.
